risk_signals: affects compaction planning and WAL-replay cutoff
reason: The new constant is a string written into block meta.json hints and read by the planner and inOrderBlocksMaxTime, so its value is a persisted format.
headline: Add from-selected-series compaction hint constant
summary: Adds CompactionHintFromSelectedSeries ("from-selected-series"), which is persisted in block meta.json Compaction.Hints. Other changes in the PR use it to keep selected-series blocks apart from other blocks in the planner and to exclude them from inOrderBlocksMaxTime.
focus: the string value is persisted on disk, so it must stay stable once released
older Prometheus versions that read these blocks will not recognize the hint and will treat them as regular blocks for WAL replay cutoff
